title: Early standalone prototypes: stills for the CA presentation
note: Stills of the owner's early standalone prototype repositories at their last documented snapshots, not of the current VisuAlgo+ app. Each repo was cloned fresh, checked out at the listed commit, installed with npm ci from its own lockfile and run on its own Vite dev server. Only the real UI was driven (clicks, selects, typing, mouse wheel). No source edits, injected state, CSS changes or added annotations.

environment.waits: network idle and document.fonts.ready after load and before each screenshot, plus a 2 to 2.5 s settle for layout and transitions
environment.pointer: moved to the bottom-right corner before each screenshot so no hover state shows

input.tree: The workspace's default tree at load: root 8, 7 nodes

actions: Click Next 9 times (1 / 21 to 10 / 21); Play is never pressed
images.shows: Preprocessing at step 10 / 21: the ancestor table up[v][k] is built column by column. Columns k=0 and k=1 are filled, k=2 is in progress with uncomputed cells shown as '…', and the amber cells are the entries the rule reads for node 14 (mid = up[14][1] = 8, ancestor = up[8][1] = 8). actions: Type 24 into Input size and click Generate / regenerate
Click Next operation 100 times (shared Tick 100); Play is never pressed

The shared Reset / Previous / Play / Next controls sit under both panes.
